using System; using System.Linq; using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor;
public static class LobbyUIProbe088 {public static string Run(){var s=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene();var g=s.GetRootGameObjects().First(x=>x.name=="Leaderboard");return string.Join("\n",g.GetComponentsInChildren<RectTransform>(true).Select(t=>t.name+" size="+t.rect.size+" localScale="+t.localScale+" localPos="+t.localPosition+" rotation="+t.localEulerAngles));}}
